epistemicNotice: Geometry and explicit modern structural component matches only; no semantic, phonetic, etymological or grading claims. Unmapped does not mean absent.

derivation.componentKeys: Literal original-source IDS glyphs; no alias normalization or Atlas IDs.
derivation.matches: Explicit source match paths under the literal original-source node, including all its descendant paths; repeated glyph occurrences are unioned.
derivation.geometryGate: Ordered full SVG stroke path arrays must equal the pinned graphics record exactly.
derivation.wholeCharacter: Each geometry-verified character also maps itself to every stroke.
derivation.conservativeExclusions: No recursive component projection, no replacement-tree path projection, and no component matches from characters with any unassigned source stroke. Resolved IDS may differ from original IDS retained below.
derivation.unmappedReason: Curriculum recursive component has no accepted literal original-source match; it may be nested only, source-resolved, or have unassigned/invalid source matches.
